title: Mechanochemical synthesis of Sb3+-doped Cs2ZrCl6 double perovskites for excitation-wavelength-responsive trimodal luminescence and high-level anti-counterfeiting
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26800-26806
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03637B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qiaochu Chen, Xuehan Ma, Guifu Dong, Hongbin Yan
This work pioneers a rapid (3 min) ethanol-assisted mechanochemical synthesis of Sb3+-doped Cs2ZrCl6 double perovskites, enabling high-level anti-counterfeiting with switchable encryption via scalable, eco-friendly production.
